text.tspan: "A symbolic image of Scylla in the context of a cave and black hole entropy. The scene is set inside a dark, jagged cave, evoking Plato's allegory.
Scylla emerges as a mythical figure, navigating the treacherous waters of deception and silence within the cave. The central chamber contains a black
hole vortex pulling in words like 'Currency of Lie' and 'Engineered Compliance', symbolizing entropy. Figures are silhouetted, some frozen near the
red vortex, while others reach toward the green wall. A faint beam of light pierces the cave roof, illuminating the path to reclamation."
